title: Spatio-Temporal Modeling of NYC Collision Data, with Difference-in-Difference for Causal Inference
description: I use Stan to combine BYM2 modeling with temporal hierarchy and a DiD term to estimate a causal effect of congestion pricing on collisions. This takes place in a Bayesian workflow setting.

title: Implementing Stan BYM2 and ICAR Models to Spatially Model Traffic Collisions in NYC
description: Using a Bayesian modeling workflow to implement Stan-based spatial dependency models of vehicle crash count data in NYC. I use BYM2 and ICAR models to explore how best to account for spatial variation.

title: Collisions and Congestion Pricing in NYC, an Exploratory Data Analysis
description: Exploratory data analysis of 2024-25 NYC vehicle collisions, with an eye on understanding the data so I can model crashes at the census tract level and discern a causal effect of the Congestion Pricing policy implemented in January, 2025.

title: Modeling the Effect of the RapidRide Program on Bus Reliability in Seattle, WA, Using Regression and Bayesian Additive Regression Trees
description: Full text of my master's thesis for QMSS, a project focused on using causal inference and machine learning to asses whether a bus upgrade policy in Seattle, WA, was worthwhile.

title: Exploring the Relationship between Trifectas in State Governments and Spending on Education using Multilevel Modeling
description: Final project for Topics in Modeling course taught by Dr. Andrew Gelman

title: Redacted: Exploring Censorship in Modern America
description: Streamlit-powered website containing data visualizations about censorship in the modern United States. Completed as part of the final project for QMSS Data Visualization course @ Columbia University.

title: Text and Network Visualization with ArXiv Papers
description: Using text analysis and network visualizations to explore trends and patterns within a dataset of ArXiv papers. Done for QMSS Data Visualization course.

title: Visualizing and Exploring NYC Parking Violation Data
description: Using data visualization with a focus on geographic data and mapping to explore NYC Parking Violation data. Done for QMSS Data Visualization course.

title: Visualizing the ‘How Couples Meet and Stay Together’ Survey by Rosenfeld et al, 2018
description: Applying data visualization foundational principles on HCMST dataset. Done for QMSS Data Visualization course.
